title: Reflection of a single comparison tensor test
statement: Let X be a scheme and A a discrete commutative ring in max(v,u+1). Let P be any cochain complex of modules over the constant ring on the coefficient-sized etale site, M any module sheaf on that site, and q any integer. If degree-q homology of the ordinary total tensor of the termwise canonical comparison inverse image of P with the degree-zero canonical inverse image of M vanishes, then degree-q homology of the ordinary total tensor of P with M in degree zero vanishes. No K-flatness, constructibility, boundedness or Noetherian hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Apply exactness and faithfulness of the intrinsic coefficient-sized comparison module pullback. Its left adjoint preserves finite colimits, so finite-limit preservation makes it homology preserving.

Construct the supplied ringed-topos morphism from the canonical continuous site comparison and constant-section ring map. Its tensor pullback is left adjoint to the specified module pushforward, hence naturally isomorphic to constructibleComparisonPullback. Transport the canonical ordinary tensor-product comparison and its naturality through this left-adjoint isomorphism.

The mapBifunctorSingle₂Iso identifies the ordinary total tensor with M in degree zero with the termwise tensor-right complex. The natural tensor comparison supplies an isomorphism between pullback of that complex and the tensor-right complex after pullback. Homology preservation identifies its homology with the pullback of etale homology. Use faithfulness to reflect id=0, then transport back through the single-tensor isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07A4; ordinary tensor comparison, single-factor totalization, exact homology comparison and faithful reflection of id=0, all proved in Lean.

theorem constructibleComparisonTensorTest_reflects_zero (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A]
    (P : ConstantCompletion.Cx (ConstantCompletion.constant
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A))
    (M : ConstantCompletion.Mod (ConstantCompletion.constant
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A)) (q : ℤ)
    (hzero : IsZero (coefficientModelTensorTest (ConstantCompletion.constant
      (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A)
        ((constructibleComparisonComplexPullback X A).obj P)
        ((constructibleComparisonPullback X A).obj M) q)) :
    IsZero (coefficientModelTensorTest (ConstantCompletion.constant
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A) P M q)
